title: Mock Server Pattern — Companion Code
description: Zero-dependency mock server implementations in Python (http.server) and Node.js (node:http): register stubs per test, record incoming requests, run on a random local port, and verify calls afterwards — the same configure-intercept-match-verify lifecycle as WireMock, nock and MSW, with full test suites for both.
description_es: Implementaciones de mock server sin dependencias en Python (http.server) y Node.js (node:http): registra stubs por test, graba las peticiones entrantes, corre en un puerto local aleatorio y verifica las llamadas después — el mismo ciclo configurar-interceptar-matchear-verificar que WireMock, nock y MSW, con suites de test completas en ambos.
